summary: A family learns that a permit staff recommends approving carries a lasting obligation on its deed.
realLife: The Nollans were told that their application was on the administrative calendar and that staff wanted an access easement. They objected before the commission approved the permit with the condition.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with family, calendar, condition. An applicant can support the construction approval and ask to be heard on the deed restriction.

turns.what: An applicant asks the chair to pull a permit from the routine calendar before the vote.
turns.pulledBy: The proposed deed language first appeared in the published packet.
turns.writesBack: The chair schedules discussion of the condition.

turns.what: The chair approves the other routine permits and holds the family's application for a separate vote.
turns.pulledBy: The clerk can identify the disputed item before the calendar vote.
turns.writesBack: The minutes give the family's permit its own disposition.
